Acid Spit.name: Acid Spit
Acid Spit.description: Attack: 5 Sec spit, acid damage 1d10 per Practitioner Title, range 3` per Practitioner Title.

Air Jets.name: Air Jets
Air Jets.description: Double swim speed for 10 sec, 10 min. to replinish.

Ambidextrous.name: Ambidextrous
Ambidextrous.description: 10 seconds of combat time, both hands, no off-hand penalties.

Antlers.name: Antlers
Antlers.description: Attack:5 sec/4 minimum, 1d4 damage piercing per antler, 1d4 antlers per Practitioner Title.

Barbed Tail.name: Barbed Tail
Barbed Tail.description: Attack:5 sec/4 minimum, 2d6+2 piercing damage, 50% chance to break off in pierced wound, 1d6+1 damage when removed.

Bioluminescence.name: Bioluminescence
Bioluminescence.description: Produces low light (equivalent of a candle, 20` of dim light) from a body area.

Blood Siphon.name: Blood Siphon
Blood Siphon.description: Siphon blood after another successful attack (or attatched to an open wound), does 1d4 base Endurance every 5 seconds.

Blowhole.name: Blowhole
Blowhole.description: Allows nearly continous swimming, +20% Swimming Skill.

Claws(Raking).name: Claws(Raking)
Claws(Raking).description: Gives second raking claw attack when grappled, as other claws but +1 per die.

Dance Language.name: Dance Language
Dance Language.description: Can pass information through complex body movement, especially dance.

Desert Endurance.name: Desert Endurance
Desert Endurance.description: Delay need to drink or eat for up to one week.

Digestive Fluid.name: Digestive Fluid
Digestive Fluid.description: Attack: 1d10 acid damage per Practitioner Title per 10 seconds if within 5` range.

Disease Bearing.name: Disease Bearing
Disease Bearing.description: Carries a random or GM selected disease.

Diving(Aerial).name: Diving(Aerial)
Diving(Aerial).description: No Agility save needed to avoid crashing from dives.

Diving(Water).name: Diving(Water)
Diving(Water).description: Gains Diving Social Skill (or +20% to existing Diving Skill).

Dormant State(Advanced).name: Dormant State(Advanced)
Dormant State(Advanced).description: Sleep for up to 1 month per Practitioner Title. Then wake ravenous, needing to ingest double food quantities for 1 day per week of hibernation. Physical attributes temporarily reduced by 1 per month of hibernation, returning by 1 per week after awakening. 2% of body weight is lost per month of hibernation and returns at 2% per week.

Echo Location.name: Echo Location
Echo Location.description: Locate objects within 2 feet per Intelligence.

Endurance.name: Endurance
Endurance.description: Grants +2 per Endurance per Practitioner Title.

Enhanced Hearing.name: Enhanced Hearing
Enhanced Hearing.description: Grants -20% to be surprised, +30% to Listen Skill.

Enhanced Taste.name: Enhanced Taste
Enhanced Taste.description: Identify poisons or impurities with a single drop/morsel.

Enhanced Touch.name: Enhanced Touch
Enhanced Touch.description: Grants +15% to perception search by touch.

Enhanced Touch(Whiskers).name: Enhanced Touch(Whiskers)
Enhanced Touch(Whiskers).description: Grants +15% to perception search by touch.

Exceptionally Hearty.name: Exceptionally Hearty
Exceptionally Hearty.description: Takes four times as long to fatigue as normal for Vitality rating.

Exceptional Sight.name: Exceptional Sight
Exceptional Sight.description: Vision range x2, Missile Weapons +1 to Hit.

Extra Insect Legs.name: Extra Insect Legs
Extra Insect Legs.description: Gains Scurry movement and insect legs, etc.

Extra Insect Arms.name: Extra Insect Arms
Extra Insect Arms.description: Gains extra pair of arms, forearms and claw-like hands.

Extra Legs.name: Extra Legs
Extra Legs.description: Gains Gallop movement and legs, etc.

Extra Limbs(Arms).name: Extra Limbs(Arms)
Extra Limbs(Arms).description: Gains pair of extra arms, forearms and hands/paws/pads, etc.

Extra Limbs(Tail).name: Extra Limbs(Tail)
Extra Limbs(Tail).description: Gains a tail, 1/2 Endurance body area.

Extra Torsos(Fore/Hind).name: Extra Torsos(Fore/Hind)
Extra Torsos(Fore/Hind).description: Gains fore and hindquarters `taur`. Needs Extra Legs to complete transformation.

Extra Torsos(Segments).name: Extra Torsos(Segments)
Extra Torsos(Segments).description: Gains additional segments like a worm or snake.

Farsight.name: Farsight
Farsight.description: Vison range x3, Missile Weapons +2 to Hit., +25% Surprise, -25% to be surprised.

Fins/Flippers/Fluke.name: Fins/Flippers/Fluke
Fins/Flippers/Fluke.description: Increases swimming speed and the skill by 20%.

Fins/Flippers/Flukes.name: Fins/Flippers/Flukes
Fins/Flippers/Flukes.description: Increases swimming speed and the skill by 20%.

Fins/Fluke.name: Fins/Fluke
Fins/Fluke.description: Increases swimming speed and the skill by 20%.

Fins.name: Fins
Fins.description: Increases swimming speed and the skill by 20%.

Flippers.name: Flippers
Flippers.description: Increases swimming speed and the skill by 20%.

Fluke.name: Fluke
Fluke.description: Increases swimming speed and the skill by 20%.

Flukes.name: Flukes
Flukes.description: Increases swimming speed and the skill by 20%.

Food Conservation.name: Food Conservation
Food Conservation.description: Half food intake, can go without twice as long.

Fused Torsos/Head.name: Fused Torsos/Head
Fused Torsos/Head.description: Torsos or head/torso fuse together, like a spider. Needs Extra Insect Arms/Insect Limbs to complete transformation.

Gas Bladder.name: Gas Bladder
Gas Bladder.description: Holds lighter than air gasses, maintains neutral buoyancy in air.

Gas Bag.name: Gas Bag
Gas Bag.description: Holds lighter than air gasses, maintains neutral buoyancy in air.

Glide Wings.name: Glide Wings
Glide Wings.description: Membranous tissue covering arm to thigh. Allows slow descent glide.

Glue Secretion.name: Glue Secretion
Glue Secretion.description: Glue can be secreted from a body area to make it adhesive, or smeared on a surface. Strength Save -20% for victim to escape.

Heat Sensing.name: Heat Sensing
Heat Sensing.description: Sense heat at a range of 2` per Intelligence.

Hibernation.name: Hibernation
Hibernation.description: Sleep for up to 1 month per Practitioner Title. Then wake ravenous, needing to ingest double food quantities for 1 day per week of hibernation. Physical attributes temporarily reduced by 1 per month of hibernation, returning by 1 per week after awakening. 2% of body weight is lost per month of hibernation and returns at 2% per week.

Hide(Bone).name: Hide(Bone)
Hide(Bone).description: Gains 4 points of Hide per Practitioner Title (maximum of 25).

Hide(Carapace).name: Hide(Carapace)
Hide(Carapace).description: Gains 4 points of Hide per Practitioner Title (maximum of 25).

Hide(Chitinous).name: Hide(Chitinous)
Hide(Chitinous).description: Gains 5 points of Hide per Practitioner Title (maximum of 30).

Hide(Feathers).name: Hide(Feathers)
Hide(Feathers).description: Gains 1 point of Hide per Practitioner Title (maximum of 10).

Hide(Fur).name: Hide(Fur)
Hide(Fur).description: Gains 2 points of Hide per Practitioner Title (maximum of 15).

Hide(Scales).name: Hide(Scales)
Hide(Scales).description: Gains 3 points of Hide per Practitioner Title (maximum of 20).

Hide(Skin).name: Hide(Skin)
Hide(Skin).description: Gains 1 point of Hide per Practitioner Title (maximum of 10).

Hide(Thick).name: Hide(Thick)
Hide(Thick).description: Gains 1 point of Hide per Practitioner Title (maximum of 10).

High Pain Threshold.name: High Pain Threshold
High Pain Threshold.description: Grants -1 damage per hit from weapons/energy.

Hooves.name: Hooves
Hooves.description: Grants 1.5 ground movement speed, Climb Skill -50%.

Horn.name: Horn
Horn.description: Attack: 5 Sec, 4 minimum, 1d6 piercing damage per Practitioner Title.

Horns.name: Horns
Horns.description: Attack: 5 Sec, 4 minimum, 1d4 piercing damage per horn, no more than 1d4 horns per Practitioner Title.

Hypnotic Gaze.name: Hypnotic Gaze
Hypnotic Gaze.description: Control Resistance or victim remains motionless until the being breaks contact or attacks.

Inflation.name: Inflation
Inflation.description: Increases the size of a specific body area by 20%, +20% to Intimidation Skill, -2 to damage taken to that area while inflated.

Ink Spray.name: Ink Spray
Ink Spray.description: Emits underwater ink spray, perception needed to find being. 10+ seconds after spray, double perception to find being. Usage once per minute per Title.

Insect Limbs.name: Insect Limbs
Insect Limbs.description: Gains extra pair of arms, forearms and claw-like hands.

Instinct(Food).name: Instinct(Food)
Instinct(Food).description: Sense distance and direction of nearest food. Chance is Rating 13 vs Intelligence x 5%. Range 1 mile per Practitioner Title.

Instinct(Life).name: Instinct(Life)
Instinct(Life).description: Sense distance and direction of nearest life. Chance is Rating 12 vs Intelligence x 5%. Range 1 mile per Practitioner Title.

Instinct(Social).name: Instinct(Social)
Instinct(Social).description: Sense nearest animal or group matching the evoke animal form. Chance is Rating 15 vs Intelligence x 5%. Range 1 mile per Practitioner Title.

Instinct(Water).name: Instinct(Water)
Instinct(Water).description: Sense distance and direction of nearest water. Chance is Rating 12 vs Intelligence x 5%. Range 1 mile per Practitioner Title.

Jumping.name: Jumping
Jumping.description: Jump x2 upward and x3 forward.

Marsupial Pouch.name: Marsupial Pouch
Marsupial Pouch.description: Gains a pouch able to hold 5 lb. per 100 lb. of Evoker.

Mandibles.name: Mandibles
Mandibles.description: Attack: 7 sec/5 minimum, 5d6 crushing damage. Smaller creatures must win contest of Strength to escape.

Metabolic Control(2-Stage High).name: Metabolic Control(2-Stage High)
Metabolic Control(2-Stage High).description: Shift between normal metabolism and very high metabolism.

Metabolic Control(2-Stage Low).name: Metabolic Control(2-Stage Low)
Metabolic Control(2-Stage Low).description: Shift between normal metabolism and very slow metabolism.

Metabolic Control(High).name: Metabolic Control(High)
Metabolic Control(High).description: Shift between any metabolism rate at will.

Metabolic Control(Low).name: Metabolic Control(Low)
Metabolic Control(Low).description: Shift between normal metabolism and very slow metabolism.

Metabolism(Very Slow).name: Metabolism(Very Slow)
Metabolism(Very Slow).description: -50% food intake/+20% weight,+2 Initiative, movement is 50%.

Mucous.name: Mucous
Mucous.description: Mucous can be secreted from a body area to make it adhesive, or smeared on a surface. Strength Save for victim to escape.

Musk Spray.name: Musk Spray
Musk Spray.description: Spray 1 victim per 5 sec. (automatic hit). Victim must make a Vitality save once per 10 sec. or be incapacitated.

Night Vision.name: Night Vision
Night Vision.description: Near darkness vision. Bright light: blinds 1d6+1 sec. -2 to hit/+1 initiative after.

Night Vision(Enhanced).name: Night Vision(Enhanced)
Night Vision(Enhanced).description: Near darkness vision without bright light penalties.

Padded Feet.name: Padded Feet
Padded Feet.description: Movement on shifting/loose/slick surfaces is normal.

Patterned Fur.name: Patterned Fur
Patterned Fur.description: Grants +10% to Blend, +5% to Move Unseen in matching terrain.

Patterned Fur(Scales).name: Patterned Fur(Scales)
Patterned Fur(Scales).description: Grants +10% to Blend, +5% to Move Unseen in matching terrain.

Pincers.name: Pincers
Pincers.description: Attack: 7 sec/5 minimum, 5d6 crushing damage. Smaller creatures must win contest of Strength to escape.

Pincers/Mandibles.name: Pincers/Mandibles
Pincers/Mandibles.description: Attack: 7 sec/5 minimum, 5d6 crushing damage. Smaller creatures must win contest of Strength to escape.

Poisonous Skin.name: Poisonous Skin
Poisonous Skin.description: Poison Type=Practitioner Title or less. Potency Q (Instant).

Poisonous Spit.name: Poisonous Spit
Poisonous Spit.description: Poison Type=Practitioner Title or less, half dagger range. Potency Q (Instant).

Prehensile Limb.name: Prehensile Limb
Prehensile Limb.description: Can grasp/lift objects or hold the body weight of the being.

Prehensile Limbs.name: Prehensile Limbs
Prehensile Limbs.description: Limbs that can grasp/lift objects or hold the body weight of the being.

Prehensile Tail.name: Prehensile Tail
Prehensile Tail.description: Can grasp/lift objects or hold the body weight of the being.

Quiet Flier.name: Quiet Flier
Quiet Flier.description: Nearly silent flight. -20% to other`s Listen/Perception to detect when close. +20% Surprise Attack Skill while flying.

Quills.name: Quills
Quills.description: Attack: 3 sec/2 minimum, 3d4 percing damage per quill, dagger range. 1+ areas have quills, 1d4 quills grown per Practitioner Title.

Regeneration(Budding).name: Regeneration(Budding)
Regeneration(Budding).description: Limbs regrow at healing rate, but vitals kill, acid/fire stop regrowth. Amputated limbs regrow into half-sized beings.

Regeneration(Natural).name: Regeneration(Natural)
Regeneration(Natural).description: Limbs regrow at healing rate, but vitals kill, acid/fire stop regrowth.

Roar.name: Roar
Roar.description: 10 Intelligence or less beings/creatures flee in panic.

Roar/Scream.name: Roar/Scream
Roar/Scream.description: 10 Intelligence or less beings/creatures flee in panic.

Scream.name: Scream
Scream.description: 10 Intelligence or less beings/creatures flee in panic.

Shocking Sting.name: Shocking Sting
Shocking Sting.description: Immune to electricity, 1 body area per 2 titles can shock for 1d8 electricity per 2 titles by touch once per 5 seconds.

Social Bonding.name: Social Bonding
Social Bonding.description: Call nearest animal or group matching animal type.

Spikes.name: Spikes
Spikes.description: Attack: 5 sec/4 minimum, 1d4 piercing damage per spike, no more than 1d4 spikes per Practitioner Title.

Sticky Tongue.name: Sticky Tongue
Sticky Tongue.description: Attack: 3 sec, extends 3x being`s height, STR save to escape.

Tail.name: Tail
Tail.description: Gains a tail, 1/2x Endurance body area.

Tail(Large).name: Tail(Large)
Tail(Large).description: Gains a tail, 1x Endurance body area.

Tail Slap.name: Tail Slap
Tail Slap.description: Attack: 3 sec/2 minimum, 3d4 smashing damage. Gains a tail 1x Endurance body area if not already present.

Tentacles.name: Tentacles
Tentacles.description: Limbs that can grasp/lift objects or hold the body weight of the being.

Tusks.name: Tusks
Tusks.description: Attack: 5 sec/4 minimum, 1d4 piercing damage per tusk, no more than 1d4 tusks per Practitioner Title.

Venom.name: Venom
Venom.description: Gain Poison Type=Practitioner Title or less, generally delivered by some other mechanics, bite, sting, skin, etc. If none of these are invoked then the being`s flesh is posionous when consumed. Potency Q (Instant).

Water Sac.name: Water Sac
Water Sac.description: Stores 1 month`s water supply for the evoker.

Web Weaving.name: Web Weaving
Web Weaving.description: Strong webs are web strength of being`s Endurance, and Hide equal to the being`s Vitality. Sticky webs are 1/2 Endurance but cause entanglement: Strength Save at -50% to escape. Both types shoot to dagger range.

Wood Cutting.name: Wood Cutting
Wood Cutting.description: Cuts up to 1 inch of wood or weaker material per minute.

Barkhide.name: Barkhide
Barkhide.description: 1 point of hide per 5 Endurance, -1 Appearance per 5 points of hide. 20 hide maximum.

Force of Wood.name: Force of Wood
Force of Wood.description: Grants +30% to the Force Skill. Can also cause 1 point of structural damage per minute.

Light Regeneration.name: Light Regeneration
Light Regeneration.description: Regeneration of 1 point of damage, per 10 minutes in full sunlight, to all wounded areas.

Rooted.name: Rooted
Rooted.description: +20% to Brace Skill and any saves or contests involving Agility or Strength against being moved or toppled, cannot move while this ability is evoked and cannot be evoked over stone, metal or similar hard surface.

Tree Merge.name: Tree Merge
Tree Merge.description: Can merge into any tree, losing current form and become one with the tree, dying only when the tree is killed. Can leave the tree at any time.

Tree Walk.name: Tree Walk
Tree Walk.description: Can enter any tree and then appear in any other tree in the same forest. A forest is defined as any group of trees where no tree is more than 100 feet from the next.
